**STEP 3 - Items:** (1) lamb shank, (2) stuffed baked item at top, (3) pig's trotter/knuckle pieces at left, (4) two golden puddings, (5) fries. No visible sauce or oil pool.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About half of a dinner plate covered with a bone-in meat portion, a stuffed item, and sides gives roughly 500–600 g and about 1,200 kcal. This is plausible for a hearty plated main. The stuffed item and trotter are hard to identify from the photo, so their values are the least certain.
